column1: # Comparison with the default layout proposed by ESPHome 2026.10.
# - The partition table consumes the next 0x1000.
# - The app partitions have 64 KB alignment enforced by gen_esp32part.py so there's
#   actually a 16 KB gap between the end of phy_init and app0.
# - The NVS partition is 448 KB which is more than ample even accounting for wear leveling
#   and it only needs 4 KB alignment so we can move it into the gap above and shrink it
#   to make more room for the app.  ESPHome preferences change fairly infrequently.
